description_en: Queries a list of remediation templates for a managed rule
description_zh: 获取修正模板列表信息
kebab_example: aliyun config list-remediation-templates --remediation-type OOS --managed-rule-identifier oss-bucket-public-write-prohibited --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRemediationTemplates

parameters.help_en: The type of the remediation template. Valid value: OOS, which stands for Operation Orchestration Service
parameters.help_zh: 修正类型。仅支持OOS（运维编排）
parameters.name: remediation_type

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the managed rule.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/261176.html operation to obtain the managed rule identifier
parameters.help_zh:
规则模板标识。

关于如何获取规则模板标识，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/261176.html
parameters.name: managed_rule_identifier

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1
parameters.help_zh: 修正模板列表的页码。起始值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

取值范围：1~100，默认值：20
parameters.name: page_size

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 修正模板列表的页码。起始值：1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。取值范围：1~100

RemediationType.description_en: The type of the remediation template. Valid value: OOS, which indicates Operation Orchestration Service
RemediationType.description_zh: 修正类型。仅支持OOS（运维编排）

TemplateDefinition.description_en: The definition of the remediation template
TemplateDefinition.example: {   "Parameters": {     "bucketName": {       "Default": "{resourceId}",       "Description": {         "zh-cn": "[Required]OSS Bucket名称。",         "en": "[Required]OSS Bucket名称。"       },       "Type": "String"     },     "regionId": {       "AssociationProperty": "RegionId",       "Default": "{regionId}",       "Description": {         "zh-cn": "[Required]The id of target region.",         "en": "[Required]The id of target region."       },       "Type": "String"     },     "permissionName": {       "AllowValues": "[\"public-read-write\",\"public-read\",\"private\"]",       "Default": "private",       "Description": {         "zh-cn": "[Required]ACL权限名称。",         "en": "[Required]ACL权限名称。"       },       "Type": "String"     }   } }

TemplateDescription.description_en: The description of the remediation template
TemplateDescription.example: 通过接口PutBucketACL，设置或修改存储空间（Bucket）的访问权限（ACL），请您知晓风险谨慎操作。

TemplateIdentifier.description_en: The ID of the remediation template

TemplateName.description_en: The name of the remediation template
TemplateName.example: 设置OSS Bucket的访问权限为私有。

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of remediation templates
